description:
The best leaders, revolutionaries and movement-makers came from a place of heightened and unusual inspiration.

Their genius was less about the ability to execute on the dream and more about the capacity to create the dream. [They found followers who enrolled in their mission and made the vision real].

Yet here’s the point I wish to make: you can’t inspire others if you are feeling uninspired.

Actively work to keep your enthusiasm and inner fire high. Be with art. Go to conferences. Travel. Explore.

Because I know that when human beings are able to fully express their gifts and talents and do work that wows, it doesn’t only alter their life - it shifts the entire world around them.

Tell me in the comments below - how do you stay inspired?

Much love and deep peace,
Robin
